articles.title: Big Change: Power Plants May Soon Pollute More
articles.summary: The EPA wants to scrap rules that limit pollution from coal and gas power plants. Supporters say it will make energy cheaper. Critics warn it could mean more asthma and hotter summers.

articles.title: A City Gave Black Families $25,000. Now the Government Is Suing.
articles.summary: Evanston, Illinois, gave $25,000 grants to Black residents to make up for past housing discrimination. Now the Trump administration is trying to stop the program, saying it's unfair.

articles.title: A British Party Got a Huge Gift. Is It Fair?
articles.summary: Nigel Farage's Reform UK party received £72 million from two wealthy donors. The government wants to cap donations from people living abroad, but Farage says the gifts are legal.
